scope: Titration notebook individual removal, evidence labels, capacity, and one-step persistent undo

unit.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/titration_notebook_removal.test.js tests/titration_investigation.test.js tests/titration_investigation_report.test.js tests/titration_immersive_bench.test.js tests/titration_focus_relationships.test.js --pool=forks --no-isolate --maxWorkers=1 --testTimeout=30000

checks: Notebook evidence labels, full-capacity removal, exact undo including notes and guide attribution, paused/other setups, serialized recovery, last removal only, new edits and reused IDs, clear recovery, last row, keyboard focus, plot selection, forced colors and stable 3D viewer pass.
Prediction diagrams: guide disclosure, keyboard range controls, exact scale changes, boundary and off-scale predictions, saved-state isolation, report preview and static exported diagram pass.

Report preview and real download preserve saved evidence and notes; keyboard open/close/Escape, other live setups, free exploration, long and hostile text, Unicode truncation, print control/media, invalidation and remount pass.
Actual additions and shared notebook saves drive all five steps; older notebook data is excluded, notes and practice records persist, and serialized remount restores the completed study.

Keyboard focus, optional hints, invalid predictions, setup pause/restore, free exploration, cleared/full notebooks, revisiting volume, 3D viewer identity, context-loss fallback, and forced colors pass.
browser.rerunNote: The first fixture assumed removal selects the first surviving plotted reading. The existing plot selects its most recent surviving reading. The assertion now checks that selection belongs to a surviving row; the final run passed.

limits: Scoped validation, not the full repository suite.
Forced-color axe scans exclude the contrast rule; applicable rules, layout, and ARIA checks run.
Browser emulation rather than physical-device or classroom testing.
